# Kids' Minds Matter

> > Kids' Minds Matter is a nonprofit organization dedicated to improving pediatric mental health services and advocacy in Southwest Florida, partnering with Lee Health, Golisano Children's Hospital, and community organizations.

Founded in 2016 by Anne Frazier and advocates in Southwest Florida, Kids' Minds Matter addresses the pediatric mental health crisis through fundraising, the Mental Health Navigator Program, community education via Mental Health Mondays, and partnerships across Lee County, Collier County, and surrounding communities including Naples, Bonita Springs, and Cape Coral.
